review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (Orange County Regional History Center HVAC, Florida), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during the same low-intensity corpus-hunting pass as e2508-gas-m103.json. Screened for image coverage first, per this same pass's own Run 86 finding on a different sheet (a hybrid raster-background sheet elsewhere in this pass's own search): this sheet reads `imgRatio` effectively 0 (real vector CAD, not a scanned background), safe to sweep.

A text-anchor scan of M-102 found abundant real chilled-water callouts using a labeling convention new to this grammar: `2"CHWS&R`, `3"CHWS&R`, `2 1/2"CHWS&R`, `8"CHWS&R` -- an `&` combined-system separator (one drawn twin-pipe run described as one 'supply-and-return' callout) alongside the ALREADY-supported `/` separator (`CWS/R`), and additionally missing the space between the inch mark and the system token entirely in the real extracted text (`2"CHWS&R`, not `2" CHWS&R` -- confirmed a real pdf.js extraction artifact from tight CAD kerning, not a typo in the source drawing, by testing the exact extracted string directly). Both gaps fixed this pass in `sizes.ts`: `&` added alongside `/` in `PIPE_RE`'s own trailing multi-system group and in `splitSystems`, and a new `normalizeLabelText` step inserts the missing space after a closing quote when immediately followed by a letter (before either regex ever sees the string) -- four new tests added, full corpus-wide test suites reproduce their exact pre-existing baselines with zero new failures.

`trace_run` reaches this 2.5-inch run cleanly (16.93 LF, `size-binding:beside`) and -- like `e2508-gas-m103.json` two entries prior -- the automatic bind SUCCEEDS post-fix: `size:{kind:pipe,nps_in:2.5}`, `systems:["CHWS","R"]`, matching the `2 1/2"CHWS&R` label printed directly beside the traced twin-pipe pair (visually confirmed via marked crop: a clean horizontal corridor run alongside a labeled `30x30` duct, with real valve/union symbols at both ends). Both `ambiguous` stops carry a real two-candidate fan each (confirmed via the raw `trace_run` response's own `candidates` array, not just visual inspection this time) -- the left end sits at a real valve/tee symbol with two genuine drawn directions (98.7°/257.5°), the right end sits at a real reducing-coupling symbol where the same corridor's own pipe size changes onward to `3"CHWS&R` (confirmed as the boundary this call's own single-size scope should stop at, not continue through). A reseed from the same coordinate against the freshly re-loaded, already-committed raw PDF reproduced the identical points, length, size, and system read.
scope: A single real 2 1/2-inch chilled water supply-and-return (CHWS/R, one drawn twin-pipe pair) run (16.93 LF) on the Orange County Regional History Center HVAC project's own mechanical plan, sheet M-102, from a real valve/tee symbol to a real reducing-coupling symbol where the same corridor's pipe size changes onward to 3-inch. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the continuation past either end (the same corridor's own `2"CHWS&R` and `3"CHWS&R` neighboring segments, both real, different-sized continuations of the same twin-pipe main); the `30x30` duct running parallel in the same crop; every other CHWS&R run on this same sheet (several further `2"`/`3"`/`4"`/`8"` segments, not attempted this pass) and sheet M-103's own continuation of the same piping system; a rejected candidate on this same sheet (a seed near an `8"CHWS&R` label produced a 40,018 LF cap/cap hatching-mistrace, the corpus's own recognized pathology, not used); every other sheet on this real 9-sheet plan set.
